$comment: The Apify MCP server the collector run is given (issue #926, parent #817), as a Claude Code --mcp-config document. The server is offered exactly the actors apify-limits.json allows - apify-guard.test.mjs asserts the two lists agree - so an actor nobody reviewed is neither offered nor callable. The token is ${APIFY_TOKEN}, expanded from the environment the scheduled workflow sets (#929): no Apify token, and no credential of any kind, is committed here. The actor ids marked actorIdConfirmed: false in apify-limits.json are to be confirmed in the owner's dry run, and this file is updated with them in the same change.
